metadata.purpose: Drop source values until the first notifier value permanently opens the gate.

conditions: Forward a suffix beginning after the notifier signal; skipped source values are not buffered.
Notifier values never become output values. Every next is a signal, including undefined, false and null. Completion without next is not a signal.
The shape counts values, not notifications, subscriptions or setup continuation steps.

scope.parameters: A valid Observable notifier; one source and one notifier occurrence per result subscription
scope.callbacks: No user predicate. setup.ready is an environment continuation marking return from notifier subscription, not a user callback or scheduler turn.
scope.time: Source and notifier supply time and ordering. No timer is introduced. Setup and synchronous notifier delivery occur at the subscription timestamp; equal-time inputs retain sequence order.
scope.reentrancy: Non-reentrant post-setup notifications plus explicitly modeled synchronous notifier initialization. Arbitrary nested delivery and cancellation within setup remain excluded.
exclusions: Non-Observable ObservableInput conversion, throwing observers/finalizers, arbitrary reentry and producer-abort guarantees.
Source synchronous delivery/finalizer-registration order is characterized separately from exact post-setup action traces.
subscribe/unsubscribe actions describe subscription lifecycle; an already-closed source attempt is not a live source connection.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Subscribe to notifier first, then source. A synchronous notifier next opens the gate; a synchronous error still leads to an already-closed source subscription attempt in RxJS 7.8.2.

ownership.sharing: No sharing introduced. Each result subscription owns its gate and source/notifier subscriptions; either producer may independently be hot or shared.
ownership.reset: A new execution creates fresh gate state. Late producer attempts are suppressed by closed RxJS Subscribers and are not legal model notifications.

resources.owner: current execution; attempted after notifier setup

dispatch.actionSemantics: Notifier setup is explicit. Resolve synchronous notifier events, then setup.ready. After setup, terminal notification precedes cleanup in notifier-then-source registration order. skipUntil opening releases notifier without notifying downstream.
cancellationCheckpoints: Active between resolved notifications: release live notifier and source, without completing downstream.
Cancellation inside notifier setup or observer callbacks is outside the exact-trace profile.

rules.explanation: The first notifier value releases the notifier and permanently opens the gate. It emits no source value and does not replay previously skipped values.

actions: release notifier without completing downstream or changing the gate
rules.explanation: Notifier completion without a value does not open skipUntil. Source values continue to be skipped until the source itself terminates or downstream cancels.

rules.explanation: A synchronous notifier error stops downstream. RxJS 7.8.2 skipUntil nevertheless continues to source.subscribe with an already-closed subscriber after notifier setup returns.

rules.guard: notifier setup returned after synchronous error
actions: attempt source subscription with an already-closed subscriber
dispose the returned source teardown immediately
rules.nextState: fully closed with no live subscriptions
rules.explanation: Because skipUntil has no closed check before source.subscribe, a source initializer can still run with subscriber.closed already true. Any returned teardown is immediately disposed and no downstream value or second terminal notification is allowed.
With the gate closed, source values are dropped without buffering. A later notifier signal does not recover them.
With the gate open, source values are forwarded unchanged.

rules.explanation: Source completion completes downstream even while the skipUntil gate is closed. It releases the notifier if still live, then the source.

rules.explanation: A source error is forwarded even while the skipUntil gate is closed, then releases both owned subscriptions.
